# Moz Scott

Moz Scott is the current Deputy of [District 2](https://flow.je/elections/district-2) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Moz Scott has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/moz-scott#e41)

  Not elected.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/moz-scott-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=av-nAQY5qBc)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRm8JkffBtc)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy2018-mozscott/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/moz-scott#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 2 with 56.9% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/moz-scott-2/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Obo-nb3tJYk)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230328201919/https://votemoz.je/manifesto/)
  - [2022 How Proposition List](https://web.archive.org/web/20230604111535/https://how.je/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Proposition-list-20.6.22-2.pdf)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Moz-Scott-Deputy-St-Brelade-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
